Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 21

“With no expectations, mind and self restrained, having relinquished all possessions, performing action with the body alone, one incurs no fault.”

With the body alone is the striking phrase. The work proceeds, but no inner grasping accompanies it, and that is what keeps the act from leaving a mark behind.
